convention: C_T = R_T / (0.5 rho U^2 S0), model scale, calm deep water, free to sink and trim unless stated. S0 = wetted surface at rest as defined by each source.
licensing_note: Raw source files are NOT redistributed here (licence unstated or restrictive); data/fetch/fetch_yard_data.py downloads and checksums them. The few numeric values below are individual factual measurements quoted with citation so validation reports are reproducible offline.

KCS.description: KRISO Container Ship, bare hull with rudder, Tokyo 2015 Case 2.1 (= G2010 2.2b), model 1
KCS.bulb: present (geometry not tabulated by the source; HM1984 bulb term omitted)
KCS.source: Tokyo 2015 Workshop on CFD in Ship Hydrodynamics, Case 2.1 EFD (NMRI/KRISO), file vary_Fr_2-1.xls; particulars from kcs_gc.html

JBC.description: Japan Bulk Carrier, bare hull w/o rudder, w/o ESD, Tokyo 2015 Case 1.1a (NMRI)
JBC.source: Tokyo 2015 Workshop, Case 1.1a EFD (NMRI), file [Identifier]_V&V_1-1a.xls; particulars from jbc_gc.html

KVLCC2.description: KRISO VLCC 2nd variant, design draft, MOERI tank test with rudder (G2010 case)
KVLCC2.source: MOERI towing-tank result as used by Gothenburg 2010 workshop; value and U_D=1.0%D as quoted in Eca/Hoekstra et al., 'Viscous-flow calculations for KVLCC2 in deep and shallow water' (doi:10.1007/978-94-007-6143-8_9), Table 3; particulars SIMMAN 2014

DTMB5415.description: US Navy combatant DTMB 5415 bare hull, 5.72 m geosim tested at CSSRC (ITTC uncertainty-analysis worked example), fresh water 16.5 C
DTMB5415.transom: immersed transom stern, area not tabulated (omitted)
DTMB5415.source: ITTC Recommended Procedure 7.5-02-02-02.1 (2021), 'Example for uncertainty analysis of resistance tests in towing tanks', Table 15 (CT at 16.5 C, expanded uncertainty); full-scale particulars SIMMAN 2008; nu from ITTC 7.5-02-01-03 fresh water at 16.5 C
